source_rule.zh: 只使用正式论文、项目页或作者代码；未报告字段不做推断。
source_rule.en: Official paper/project/author code only; unknown fields are not inferred.

interpretation.zh: 分别报告 API、开源权重、参数训练和外部软件／工具依赖。
interpretation.en: API access, open weights, parameter training, and external software/tools are reported separately.

primary_recommendation.zh: 主结果使用开源权重；第二个开源架构验证迁移；商业 API 仅作为可选上界或 Judge。
primary_recommendation.en: Open-weight primary results, second open architecture for transfer, commercial API only as optional ceiling/judge.

papers.title: CLOVA: A Closed-Loop Visual Assistant with Tool Usage and Update

actor.zh: 主工具使用对比以 GPT-3.5 为规划模型；论文还评测了 Llama2-7B 和 GPT-4。
actor.en: GPT-3.5 in the main tool-use comparison; the paper also evaluates Llama2-7B and GPT-4.

critic_or_judge.zh: 同一 LLM 闭环负责反思，任务专用视觉工具提供可执行反馈。
critic_or_judge.en: The same LLM loop provides reflection; task-specific visual tools provide executable feedback.

api_role.zh: GPT-3.5-turbo 和 GPT-4 属于商业 API；LIST 工具使用 text-davinci-002；Llama2-7B 是开源权重替代方案。
api_role.en: GPT-3.5-turbo and GPT-4 are commercial API models; text-davinci-002 is used by the LIST tool. Llama2-7B is the open-weight alternative.

parameter_updates.zh: 不对 LLM 做全量微调。系统保存正确/错误 demonstrations 进行上下文更新；视觉工具骨干保持冻结，只优化 soft prompts。
parameter_updates.en: No full LLM fine-tuning. Correct/incorrect demonstrations are stored for in-context updates; visual-tool backbones stay frozen while soft prompts are tuned.

data.zh: GQA、NLVRv2，以及人工收集的图像编辑和事实知识任务。
data.en: GQA, NLVRv2, plus manually collected image-editing and factual-knowledge tasks.

hardware.zh: 已检查的官方正文没有明确报告硬件。
hardware.en: Unknown in the official main paper text inspected.

code.zh: 官方项目页和代码均已公开。
code.en: Official project page and code are public.

implication.zh: 商业 API 不是闭环更新的唯一实现；低资源复现可使用本地开源规划器与冻结视觉工具，但必须单独报告 API 与开源规划器的差异。
implication.en: Commercial APIs are not the only implementation of closed-loop updating. A low-resource reproduction can use an open local planner and frozen visual tools, but API and open-planner results must be separated.

papers.title: Self-Training Large Language Models for Improved Visual Program Synthesis with Visual Reinforcement

actor.zh: 使用开源代码 LLM 进行视觉程序合成自训练；复现前需从官方配置确认精确 checkpoint 版本。
actor.en: An open code LLM is self-trained for visual program synthesis; the exact checkpoint variant must be taken from the released configuration before reproduction.

critic_or_judge.zh: 使用稀疏二元执行奖励和过滤式行为克隆；少于 50 条人工修正用于扩展训练。
critic_or_judge.en: Sparse binary execution reward and filtered behavioral cloning; fewer than 50 manually written corrections extend training.

api_role.zh: 核心方法旨在避免依赖 GPT-4 这类强商业程序生成器。
api_role.en: The core method is designed to avoid dependence on strong commercial program generators such as GPT-4.

parameter_updates.zh: 通过强化式自训练／过滤式行为克隆更新代码模型。
parameter_updates.en: The code model is updated through reinforced self-training / filtered behavioral cloning.

data.zh: 目标检测、组合式 VQA 和图文检索任务。
data.en: Object detection, compositional VQA, and image-text retrieval tasks.

hardware.zh: 精确运行硬件需进一步核对官方 PDF 或配置。
hardware.en: Unknown until the official PDF/configuration is checked for the exact run.

implication.zh: 若论文贡献依赖模型参数自进化，可以用 7B 级开源代码/VLM 做 LoRA 或小规模自训练；但当前低资源 Idea 更适合冻结主干，只更新小模块。
implication.en: When the contribution truly requires parameter self-evolution, a 7B open model can be adapted with LoRA or small-scale self-training. Most current low-resource ideas should still freeze the backbone and update only small components.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Visual Concept Library using Vision-Language Critics

actor.zh: 由视觉概念库和下游视觉推理系统组成；精确基础模型 checkpoint 需从官方配置中确认。
actor.en: A visual concept library and downstream visual reasoning system; exact foundation-model checkpoints must be read from the official configuration.

critic_or_judge.zh: 使用视觉语言 Critic 评估并修订概念。
critic_or_judge.en: Vision-language critics evaluate and refine concepts.

api_role.zh: 官方摘要确认使用 VLM Critic，但不能据此判断所有 Critic 都是 API 托管还是本地模型。
api_role.en: The official abstract establishes VLM critics but does not by itself prove whether every reported critic is API-hosted or local.

parameter_updates.zh: 主要进化对象是概念库，而不是不受限制地训练完整骨干。
parameter_updates.en: The evolving object is the concept library rather than unrestricted full-backbone training.

data.zh: 论文报告的视觉概念学习与下游识别／推理基准。
data.en: Visual concept learning and downstream recognition/reasoning benchmarks reported in the paper.

hardware.zh: 已检查的官方摘要和项目元数据没有明确报告硬件。
hardware.en: Unknown from the official abstract/project metadata inspected.

code.zh: 复现时应使用作者官方仓库；若论文页未链接仓库，则精确可用性仍标记为待确认。
code.en: Use the official author repository when reproducing; exact availability is recorded as pending if the repository is not linked from the paper page.

implication.zh: 把可进化对象限制为概念库、记忆或工具，比全量训练 VLM 更符合低资源设置；但 Critic 必须有本地可复现版本。
implication.en: Restricting evolution to a concept library, memory, or tools is more compatible with low-resource work than full VLM training, but a locally reproducible critic is required.

papers.title: VISCO: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Critique and Correction towards Self-Improvement in Visual Reasoning

actor.zh: 发布的评测支持 GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet、Gemini-1.5-Pro 等闭源模型，也支持 Qwen2-VL、Molmo、InternVL2、LLaVA、NVLM 和 Llama-3.2-Vision 等本地开源 LVLM。
actor.en: The released evaluation supports proprietary GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-1.5-Pro and many local open LVLMs including Qwen2-VL, Molmo, InternVL2, LLaVA, NVLM, and Llama-3.2-Vision families.

critic_or_judge.zh: LookBack 是推理时提示策略；发布的 explanation-F1 评测器默认使用 OpenAI API 模型，除非替换为本地评测器。
critic_or_judge.en: LookBack is an inference-time prompting strategy; the released explanation-F1 evaluator uses an OpenAI API model unless replaced.

api_role.zh: 商业 API 是被评测的一类模型，也被辅助评测器使用；开源模型可通过 vLLM、lmdeploy 或 sglang 本地运行。
api_role.en: Commercial APIs are one evaluated model group and are used by the provided assisted evaluator, but open models can be run locally through vLLM/lmdeploy/sglang.

parameter_updates.zh: Benchmark 和 LookBack 都不要求训练骨干参数。
parameter_updates.en: Benchmarking and LookBack do not require backbone training.

data.zh: 1,645 个问答对和 5,604 条细粒度步骤标注。
data.en: 1,645 question-answer pairs with 5,604 fine-grained step annotations.

hardware.zh: 本地部署需求取决于所选 LVLM，不存在统一硬件配置。
hardware.en: Local serving requirements depend on the selected LVLM; no single universal hardware setting applies.

code.zh: 官方 GitHub 仓库已公开。

implication.zh: 主实验可以完全基于本地开源 Actor/Critic；商业 API 只作为上界或辅助评测，并必须同时报告调用次数、模型版本和替代的本地评测。
implication.en: The main experiment can use local open actors and critics. Commercial APIs should be optional ceilings or assisted evaluators, with call counts, fixed versions, and a local alternative reported.

papers.title: Critic-V: VLM Critics Help Catch VLM Errors in Multimodal Reasoning

actor.zh: 将推理 VLM 与独立 Critic 配对；精确的 reasoner／critic checkpoint 应以官方代码和配置为准。
actor.en: A reasoner VLM is paired with an independent critic; exact released reasoner/critic checkpoints should be taken from the official code/configuration.

critic_or_judge.zh: Critic 使用规则奖励排序后的偏好 critique 数据进行 DPO 训练。
critic_or_judge.en: The critic is trained with DPO on preference critiques ranked by a rule-based reward.

api_role.zh: GPT-4V 作为对比模型；方法核心是独立训练 Critic，而不是仅依赖 API 的提示闭环。
api_role.en: GPT-4V is an evaluated comparison; the method contribution is an independently trained critic rather than an API-only prompt loop.

parameter_updates.zh: Critic 参数通过 DPO 更新，不属于纯推理时方法。
parameter_updates.en: Critic parameters are trained with DPO; this is not inference-only.

data.zh: 论文描述的多模态推理与 critique 数据。
data.en: Multimodal reasoning and critique data described in the paper.

hardware.zh: 精确硬件需进一步核对官方附录或配置。
hardware.en: Unknown until the official appendix/configuration is checked.

code.zh: 应使用官方论文／项目材料；当前精确仓库可用性仍标记为待确认。
code.en: Official paper/project materials should be used; exact repository availability is marked pending here.

implication.zh: 独立 Critic 能减少共享盲点，但训练 Critic 会增加成本。低资源方案应先比较冻结的异构开源 Critic，再决定是否需要小型 DPO/LoRA。
implication.en: An independent critic can reduce shared blind spots, but critic training adds cost. A low-resource study should first compare a frozen heterogeneous open critic before adding small DPO/LoRA training.

papers.title: Can Large Vision-Language Models Correct Semantic Grounding Errors By Themselves?

actor.zh: 官方研究评测 GPT-4V／GPT-4o 及其他 LVLM；纠正流程基于 Prompt，且与具体模型无关。
actor.en: The official study evaluates GPT-4V/GPT-4o and additional LVLMs; the correction procedure is prompt-based and model-agnostic.

critic_or_judge.zh: 模型执行迭代式二元验证与纠正。
critic_or_judge.en: The model performs iterative binary verification and correction.

api_role.zh: GPT 模型需要商业 API，但方法结构本身不强制依赖 API。
api_role.en: GPT models require commercial APIs, but the method itself does not structurally require API access.

parameter_updates.zh: 不进行微调、架构修改或外部训练数据注入。
parameter_updates.en: No fine-tuning, architecture change, or external training data.

data.zh: 论文报告的语义 grounding 评测集。
data.en: Semantic grounding evaluation sets reported in the paper.

hardware.zh: 托管 GPT 运行不涉及本地硬件；本地模型硬件取决于所选开源 checkpoint。
hardware.en: Not applicable to hosted GPT runs; local-model hardware depends on the selected open checkpoint.

code.zh: 官方 CVF／arXiv 材料已公开。

implication.zh: 推理时自纠正非常省训练资源，但必须控制迭代调用预算，并证明收益来自视觉复核而非更多 token 或更多采样。
implication.en: Inference-time self-correction is training-efficient, but iteration budgets must be controlled and gains must be separated from simply using more tokens or samples.

papers.title: Phoenix: A Motion-based Self-Reflection Framework for Fine-grained Robotic Action Correction

actor.zh: 将运动条件扩散策略与 MLLM 驱动的动作调整模块结合；精确 MLLM checkpoint 需从官方配置确认。
actor.en: A motion-conditioned diffusion policy is paired with an MLLM-driven motion-adjustment component; exact MLLM checkpoint should be verified from the official configuration.

critic_or_judge.zh: 基于运动的自反思提供纠正信号。

api_role.zh: 精确 MLLM 是否调用 API 仍需核对官方配置；策略本身经过训练并可本地执行。
api_role.en: Unknown for the exact MLLM until the official config is checked; the policy itself is trained and locally executable.

parameter_updates.zh: 扩散策略／持续学习组件需要训练，不是免训练方法。
parameter_updates.en: The diffusion policy/lifelong component is trained; this is not a training-free method.

data.zh: RoboMimic 仿真和真实机器人实验。
data.en: RoboMimic simulation and real-world robotic experiments.

hardware.zh: 精确训练硬件仍待官方附录或配置核验。
hardware.en: Exact training hardware remains pending official appendix/configuration verification.

code.zh: 作者官方 GitHub 仓库已公开。
code.en: Official author GitHub repository is public.

implication.zh: 完整复现成本较高。我们的具身方向应先在公开轨迹与仿真重放上冻结 OpenVLA，只训练审计器或记忆门控。
implication.en: Full reproduction is costly. Our embodied work should first freeze OpenVLA and train only an auditor or memory gate on public trajectories and simulator replay.

papers.title: Visual Agentic AI for Spatial Reasoning with a Dynamic API

actor.zh: 多个协作 LLM Agent 生成并调用动态 Python 视觉 API；精确 LLM 版本需从官方论文或配置确认。
actor.en: Collaborating LLM agents generate and use a dynamic Python visual API; exact LLM versions should be read from the official paper/configuration.

critic_or_judge.zh: 执行结果和专职 Agent 为 API 创建与调用提供反馈。
critic_or_judge.en: Execution results and specialist agents provide feedback for API creation and use.

api_role.zh: 官方摘要确认使用 LLM 程序合成，但无法单独判断所有主实验使用托管 API 还是本地开源权重。
api_role.en: The official abstract establishes LLM-based program synthesis but does not alone identify whether every main run is hosted API or local open weights.

parameter_updates.zh: 主要进化对象是动态 API／程序库，而不是训练完整基础模型。
parameter_updates.en: The evolving artifact is the dynamic API/program library; full foundation-model training is not the central mechanism.

hardware.zh: 硬件需进一步核对官方附录或配置。

implication.zh: 工具/API 进化可以冻结基础模型完成，但必须把程序生成器的 API 依赖作为变量，并提供本地开源规划器对照。
implication.en: Tool/API evolution can freeze the foundation model, but the program generator's API dependency must be treated as an experimental variable with a local open-planner control.

actor.zh: 以 Qwen2.5-VL 和 MiMo-VL 系列作为可训练 Questioner／Reasoner 基座。
actor.en: Qwen2.5-VL and MiMo-VL model families are used as trainable questioner/reasoner substrates.

critic_or_judge.zh: 自博弈难度／多样性奖励和可验证任务信号用于指导 GRPO。
critic_or_judge.en: Self-play difficulty/diversity rewards and verifiable task signals guide GRPO.

api_role.zh: 核心训练闭环不需要商业模型 API。
api_role.en: Commercial model APIs are not required for the core training loop.

parameter_updates.zh: 在大规模无标注图像上用 GRPO 联合优化 Questioner 和 Reasoner。
parameter_updates.en: Questioner and reasoner are jointly optimized with GRPO on large unlabeled-image collections.

data.zh: 大规模无标注图像和多模态推理评测集。
data.en: Large-scale unlabeled images plus multimodal reasoning evaluations.

hardware.zh: 属于高资源分布式训练；复现前应从官方附录复制精确配置。
hardware.en: High-resource distributed training; exact configuration should be copied from the official appendix before reproduction.

code.zh: 官方 GitHub 仓库已公开。

implication.zh: 它证明全参数/强化学习式视觉自进化可以用开源权重完成，但不适合作为当前低资源复现目标；应作为高资源上界。
implication.en: It demonstrates open-weight RL-style visual self-evolution, but is unsuitable as the current low-resource reproduction target and should be treated as a high-resource ceiling.

papers.title: JarvisEvo: Towards a Self-Evolving Photo Editing Agent with Synergistic Editor-Evaluator Optimization

actor.zh: 发布的 JarvisEvo-8B Editor／Evaluator 系统结合 Qwen-Image-Edit 和 Adobe Lightroom 工具空间。
actor.en: The released JarvisEvo-8B editor/evaluator stack integrates Qwen-Image-Edit and an Adobe Lightroom tool space.

critic_or_judge.zh: 项目报告通过 SFT／SEPO／RFT 等阶段优化 Editor–Evaluator 双闭环。
critic_or_judge.en: A dual editor-evaluator loop is optimized with SFT/SEPO/RFT-style stages reported by the project.

api_role.zh: 发布的 8B 模型不要求商业 LLM API，但 Adobe Lightroom 是闭源软件依赖。
api_role.en: A commercial LLM API is not required for the released 8B model, but Adobe Lightroom is a proprietary software dependency.

parameter_updates.zh: Editor／Evaluator 系统需要训练，不属于纯推理时方法。
parameter_updates.en: The editor/evaluator system is trained; this is not inference-only.

data.zh: 项目发布或描述的 ArtEdit-Bench 与图像编辑数据。
data.en: ArtEdit-Bench and editing data released/described by the project.

hardware.zh: 精确训练硬件应以官方附录为准；发布说明中推理权重约为 17 GB。
hardware.en: Exact training hardware should be taken from the official appendix; inference weights are roughly 17 GB according to the release.

code.zh: 官方 GitHub 仓库和模型权重按其许可证公开。
code.en: Official GitHub repository and model weights are public under their stated license.

implication.zh: 开源 8B 编辑 Agent 可本地验证，但闭源工具依赖仍需显式报告。低资源研究可用 SDXL/FLUX 与开源编辑工具替代。
implication.en: The open 8B editing agent can be evaluated locally, but proprietary tool dependencies must be disclosed. Low-resource work can substitute SDXL/FLUX and open editing tools.

papers.title: OctoT2I: A Self-Evolving Agentic Text-to-Image Router

actor.zh: Agent 路由器在多个文生图工具间选择，并维护持续进化的能力知识库。
actor.en: An agentic router selects among multiple text-to-image tools and maintains an evolving capability knowledge base.

critic_or_judge.zh: propose–solve–evaluate–learn 闭环评估工具能力和路由结果。
critic_or_judge.en: The propose-solve-evaluate-learn loop evaluates tool capability and routing outcomes.

api_role.zh: 每个工具的精确 API／开源权重组成仍待官方全文和发布材料确认。
api_role.en: Exact API/open-weight composition of every tool is pending verification from the official full paper and release.

parameter_updates.zh: 能力知识库／路由器持续进化，完整生成器训练不是核心贡献。
parameter_updates.en: The capability knowledge base/router evolves; unrestricted full generator training is not the central contribution.

data.zh: 论文描述的文生图 Prompt、质量与效率评测。
data.en: Text-to-image prompts and quality/efficiency evaluations described in the paper.

hardware.zh: 硬件需进一步核对官方补充材料或配置。

code.zh: 论文声明了发布计划；复现时应使用作者官方版本。
code.en: The official paper indicates release status; use the author release when available.

implication.zh: 路由和能力记忆可做低资源研究，但必须分别报告本地生成器与外部 API 工具的调用成本和可复现性。
implication.en: Routing and capability memory are low-resource research targets, but local generators and external API tools must have separate cost and reproducibility reporting.

papers.title: EvoGraph-R1: Self-Evolving Multimodal Knowledge Hypergraphs for Agentic Retrieval

actor.zh: 多模态 Agent 在动态超图上选择 GraphRetrieve、WebSearch、GraphEdit 和 Answer 动作。
actor.en: A multimodal agent selects GraphRetrieve, WebSearch, GraphEdit, and Answer actions over a dynamic hypergraph.

critic_or_judge.zh: 检索与图编辑结果构成进化信号。
critic_or_judge.en: Retrieval and graph-edit outcomes provide the evolution signal.

api_role.zh: Web 搜索是外部服务／工具；精确基础模型和 API 选择仍待官方补充材料核验。
api_role.en: Web search is an external service/tool; exact foundation-model and API choices remain pending official supplementary verification.

parameter_updates.zh: 主要进化状态是多模态图，而不一定更新基础模型权重。
parameter_updates.en: The main evolving state is the multimodal graph rather than necessarily the foundation-model weights.

data.zh: 论文报告的 Agentic 多模态检索基准。
data.en: Agentic multimodal retrieval benchmarks reported in the paper.

hardware.zh: 硬件需进一步核对官方附录或配置。

code.zh: 复现时应使用官方 CVF／项目发布版本。
code.en: Use the official CVF/project release when available.

implication.zh: 图或记忆状态进化比模型权重训练更省资源，但外部搜索服务、缓存与图版本必须进入实验成本和复现协议。
implication.en: Graph or memory-state evolution is cheaper than weight training, but external search services, caching, and graph versions must be included in cost and reproducibility protocols.
